advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the deterministic T8 regex gate's recall vocabulary covers real LLM/agent-surface phrasings (assistant/bot/classifier/'structured output'/'response format') or add an LLM fallback, since T8 is a blocking overlay with no other applicability path.
evidence: orchestrator.py:385-387: 'Deterministic overlays only run when triggered; LLM-routed overlays (those absent from the deterministic trigger map) always enter the finder, which decides applicability (PASS not-applicable is cheap).'
registry.py:429-431: 'the agent-tier T1/T3/T5c/T8/T10/T11) are LLM-routed at Pass-1 (a keyword trigger is high-FP for them), so they are NOT listed here.'
criteria_routing.json:672-674 shows T8 default_posture blocking with overlay_routing 'llm' and trigger note 'LLM-routed — a keyword trigger is high-FP'
A plan such as 'the classifier returns a JSON verdict; enumerate the labels' names an LLM output-schema surface but matches none of the regex alternations, so T8 is now dropped.
advisory.finding: T8 is converted from an LLM-routed overlay (high recall, finder decides applicability) to a fixed-vocabulary deterministic regex gate, creating a false-negative risk: LLM/agent plans phrased outside the regex vocabulary now silently skip the blocking T8 probe with no LLM fallback.
scenarios: A plan defining LLM/agent behavior using synonyms not in the regex (assistant, bot, classifier, grader, completion, structured output without the token 'model'/'LLM'/'agent') no longer receives the blocking T8 probe.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the T8 regex with the documented applicability contract (structured-output / response-format / output-schema phrasing) so routing matches the doc and prompt.
evidence: docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md:494: 'schemas/enums consumed or emitted by an LLM/tool structured-output contract'
Keep-test #1 only passes because the plan also contains the literal 'LLM' (test_plan_review.py:582), not because 'structured-output verdict schema' matches the regex.
advisory.finding: The T8 applicability regex omits the general 'structured output/response format/output schema' phrasing that the updated doc and prompt list as an applicability trigger; it only matches the narrower 'tool(s) input|output|request|response schema(s)' pattern, so LLM-output-schema plans that don't use the literal 'tool' token are excluded.
scenarios: A plan describing 'the model's structured output schema' or 'the LLM response format' without the word 'tool' relies solely on the llms?/model-prompt alternations to be routed.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a 'keeps' case whose ONLY matching token is the tool-schema branch (e.g. a plan mentioning a 'tool output schema' / 'tool response schema' with no 'LLM'/'prompt'/'agent' words) to guard the LLM/tool structured-output-contract boundary against regression.
evidence: registry.py:454 `r"tools? (?:input|output|request|response) schemas?"` — this branch encodes the docstring's central 'LLM/tool structured-output contract' case
registry.py:463-466 docstring: 'schemas consumed or emitted through an LLM/tool structured-output contract'
Positive plan at test line 582-583 matches only via `llms?` ('LLM reviewer'); plan at line 585 matches via 'reviewer prompt'/'sub-agent' — neither reaches the tool-schema branch
Exclusion plans at lines 569-570 ('JSON output schema', 'structured-output formatter') are the near-miss opposites of the untested keep case, making the boundary regression-prone and unverified
advisory.finding: The 'keeps' test does not exercise the LLM/tool structured-output-schema branch of `_T8_LLM_SURFACE_RE` (`tools? (?:input|output|request|response) schemas?`), which is the central case named by the function's docstring ('schemas consumed or emitted through an LLM/tool structured-output contract'). Both positive plans match via other tokens ('LLM', 'reviewer prompt', 'sub-agent'), so this branch is untested — while the exclusion set deliberately includes the near-miss phrasings 'JSON output schema' and 'structured-output formatter' that must be excluded. The subtle keep-vs-exclude boundary the change introduces (e.g. 'tool output schema' keeps, 'JSON output schema' excludes) is therefore not guarded against regression.
scenarios: A future edit to or accidental removal of the `tools? ... schemas?` alternative would silently stop routing genuine LLM/tool structured-output-contract plans to T8, undetected by the suite.
Regex tightening that also swallows the legitimate 'tool output schema' phrasing would go unnoticed.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add to the `test_t8_routing_keeps_llm_structured_output_plans` parametrize list a plan such as: "Specify the tool output schema and enumerate every field the tool response may contain." (contains no llm/prompt/agent token, so it can only pass via the `tools? ... schemas?` branch).
